nodes.text:
4. Why Markets React to Virus News
Markets hate uncertainty
When something like HMPV(Human Metapneumovirus) hits the headlines, fear-driven selling kicks-in—even if the actual threat is minimal.

The reaction to HMPV is more about short-term sentiment than long-term  fundamentals

nodes.author: vinayakseth1
nodes.text:
5. What Investors Should Do
If you remember March 2020, panic selling only hurt retail investors who sold at the bottom.

A. Focus on long-term fundamentals.
B. Avoid reacting emotionally to every headline.
C. Use dips to accumulate quality stocks, not to panic sell.
